book.title: Agentic AI With Python
learnings: Connect LLMs with documents, tools, and memory.
Evaluate and deploy safer agent applications.
book.description:
Agentic AI With Python is a practical, project-based guide to building AI assistants that read documents, retrieve knowledge, use tools, call APIs, remember approved context, apply guardrails, evaluate outputs, and deploy real applications.

Python is a trademark of the Python Software Foundation. This independent book is not affiliated with the PSF.
book.author: Ronik Basak
benefits: Learn RAG, tools, memory, guardrails, evaluation, and deployment.
Use safe project patterns without unnecessary live API calls.
book.about_author: Ronik Basak writes practical technical learning material for builders who want to turn ideas into useful software.
